recommendations: All experiments can be implemented as thin wrappers around existing primitives - no new core capabilities needed
Activate experiments ONLY after real friction is observed in B4/P0 execution (enforce activation gates)
ExecutionContext needs only 1 field addition (step_boundary_timestamp) to support Time-to-Next-Action tracking
Project Context can reuse existing EpistemicStatus system without modification - no new type system needed
Professional Work Package can reuse the work seed's handoffContext structure - already proven in pt-establishment.workseed.json
Leverage metrics can be fully computed from existing evidence registry and execution chain data - no new tracking infrastructure needed
